segments.headline: NVIDIA's robot model learns from people

beats.narration: NVIDIA's new robot model, Groot two, learned from videos of people at work. So how much real robot practice did it need?
direct: NVIDIA's new robot model, Groot two, learned from videos of people at work. So how much real robot practice did it need?

beats.narration: Its training mix includes over four hundred thousand hours of video of people at work.
direct: Its training mix includes over four hundred thousand hours of video of people at work.

visual.sub: of video of people at work · research.nvidia.com

beats.narration: One model imagines what happens next and plans the robot's moves together, so skills shown by people carry over.
direct: One model imagines what happens next and plans the robot's moves together, so skills shown by people carry over.

beats.narration: On fifty tasks this robot had never done, with no demonstrations, it succeeded at least once on forty.
direct: On fifty tasks this robot had never done, with no demonstrations, it succeeded at least once on forty.

beats.narration: One demonstration per task: seventy-one percent success. Five, under three minutes of robot data: ninety-five percent.
